descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S18 「现成的 spec：删除问一次，Cancel 保留，OK 删掉，没有批量删除」 Existing specs: delete asks once, Cancel keeps, OK removes, and there is no bulk delete

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 Delete asks for confirmation once; there is no bulk delete in V1.（TFA-92579 AC 2；UAT TC-24）
  • T2 Deleting a patient removes all of that patient's data immediately (hard delete, not hidden); the audit log of who accessed the chart is kept.（TFA-92579 AC 2；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given One Hospital patient (Tim's fixture)

When Click the card's remove control and dismiss / accept the first dialog; open Settings

Then One confirmation; Cancel keeps the patient; OK removes it from the list and from rounding:list; no control deletes all patients at once

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions. Hospital only, and they pass with the browser's native confirm, so they say nothing about AC 7's app-style pop-up or AC 8's toast (S16/S17), and 'removed from rounding:list' would also pass a soft delete (S20). 'Once' holds because a second dialog would be auto-dismissed and the OK test would fail

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-01.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • forms.spec.ts [chromium] — asks first, and the patient survives a cancel — expected
  • forms.spec.ts [chromium] — confirming removal deletes the patient and closes the loop — expected
  • forms.spec.ts [chromium] — offers no way to delete every patient at once — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec): its fixtures are fresh @roundai.test accounts made with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
